about: Dynv protocol v1 conformance vectors. Spec: docs/PROTOCOL.md. Generated by crates/dynv-proto/tests/protocol_vectors.rs (deterministic nonces, for reproducibility only: real clients use random nonces).

blob.about: One sealed process blob with its keys: open it, then check the plaintext document JSON and the content hash.

self.about: Process-side state machine. For each case start a fresh client (no floors, no cache) for `token` with the case's `process` name pin (null = none), then for each step run open(response); on ok, accept it (advance floors), and compare with `expect`. An error step changes no state.

cases.about: A document without shared groups.
cases.name: plain

cases.about: Groups merge in EnvDoc.shared order (later wins), the process's own vars win over all, tombstones from every source are kept, apply modes travel with the group's vars, and a group the server delivers but the document does not list is ignored.
cases.name: groups-merge

cases.about: Without a configured process name, the document's name is not checked.
cases.name: no-name-pin

cases.about: The token's process is not the configured one.
cases.name: name-pin-mismatch

cases.about: An envelope sealed to another token does not open.
cases.name: envelope-other-token

cases.about: An envelope for another process (AAD binds the process id) does not open.
cases.name: envelope-other-process

cases.about: Envelope generation 2, blob generation 1: a rotation is in flight; retry after ~250 ms.
cases.name: gen-mismatch

cases.about: A blob signed by a key the envelope does not list (the server cannot add a signer).
cases.name: untrusted-signer

cases.about: A blob sealed and signed for another process id (AAD and signature bind it).
cases.name: blob-other-process

cases.about: The server edits blob.version without re-signing.
cases.name: version-bumped

cases.about: One flipped ciphertext bit: the signature check fails before decryption.
cases.name: ciphertext-tampered

cases.about: Ids must be 16 base64url characters before they go into any AAD.
cases.name: malformed-ids

cases.about: After accepting v5, a validly signed v4 is refused; v5 again is fine; v6 is accepted.
cases.name: rollback

cases.about: Different, validly signed content at an already-accepted version is refused.
cases.name: fork

cases.about: After accepting generation 2, a generation-1 envelope and blob are refused as generation_rollback even at a higher document version and with their own valid signer.
cases.name: generation-rollback

cases.about: After accepting group generation 2, a generation-1 slot and blob are refused as generation_rollback even at a higher group version; the last good group values are kept.
cases.name: group-generation-rollback

cases.about: Each listed group that fails is skipped on its own (no last verified state yet), and the process's vars and the good group still apply.
cases.name: group-failures

cases.about: Once a group verified, a later failure (withheld, rolled back, forked) keeps its last verified values; a newer valid version applies again.
cases.name: group-keep-last

cases.about: The document lists a group but the response has no `shared` field: process vars apply, the group is skipped.
cases.name: old-server

cases.about: Keys like __proto__ and constructor are plain data; values keep escapes, non-ASCII and empty strings exactly.
cases.name: awkward-names

cases.about: A document listing a feature this client doesn't know, but not as critical, is applied.
cases.name: feature-unknown-optional

cases.about: A document listing an unknown feature as critical is refused whole; the client keeps its last good env.
cases.name: feature-unknown-critical

cases.about: A group listing an unknown critical feature is not applied (skipped, or kept at its last accepted version); the process's own vars still apply.
cases.name: feature-unknown-critical-group

cases.about: A validly signed document at version 0 is refused: versions are 1 … 2^53−1.
cases.name: zero-version

cases.about: Envelope and blob both at key generation 0, validly sealed and signed: refused (generations are 1 … 2^53−1).
cases.name: zero-generation

cases.about: A group document at version 0 (validly signed) and a slot entry at process generation 0 are malformed: both groups are skipped, the process's own vars apply.
cases.name: zero-group-values

cases.about: ${NAME} resolves against the effective env (here DB_HOST from a shared group), templates may reference templates, $$ is a literal $, a literal containing ${...} stays literal, and a template is restart-mode if anything it depends on is. A group change re-resolves the dependent value.
cases.name: templates

cases.about: When a template stops resolving (the group no longer sets DB_HOST), it keeps its last applied value and is listed as unresolved; once the dependency is back it resolves again.
cases.name: template-keeps-last-good

cases.about: Templates that cannot resolve (missing name, cycle, malformed, or depending on one that fails) on a client with no last good value are left unset and added to removed, so they never fall back to an inherited value.
cases.name: template-unresolved-fresh
